name: maleNamesBegin
note: std::vector<CString> of the hero prototype names (g_0x7AF378 0x60-byte records) whose udb mask (+0xe8) is 'unhuma' (male): the male face list (CStrings_InsertRealloc in Build)

name: femaleNamesBegin
note: std::vector<CString> of the prototypes with the female mask: the female face list

name: previewSpin
note: rotation phase of the preview unit (Time_GetSeconds fmod while a hero arrow is held, +0x1e4 1 / 2); 0 in Build; also the 0.5 s auto-repeat reference of the arrows

name: heroArrowHeld
note: 1 prev / 2 next while a hero arrow button is pressed (OnLButtonDown captures, OnLButtonUp clears); 0 in Build

name: slotNameEdit
note: CEditWin (10 chars, colours 0xa7d7e4 / 0x31b3ff) for renaming a slot (ShowSlotDetails fills it; +0x179 of it = active)

name: heroNameEdit
note: CEditWin (10 chars, white) for the new hero's name (mode 10; its text +0x170 is copied each Update); Layout / OnCancel deactivate it

name: voiceScrollBar
note: CScrollBar of the voice list (mode 10; GetChanged redraws DrawVoiceList)

name: heroProtoName
note: the prototype name of the hero being built (RebuildHeroSlots argument): picks the male / female voice list for +0x210

name: maleVoicesBegin
note: std::vector of 8-byte {CString protoName, CString label} (StringPair) voice sets of the male prototypes that have a voice (record byte +0x5c): label = lmp_male_voice + ' %d'; freed by DtorBody (PoolFree_N8)

name: femaleVoicesBegin
note: the female voice-set pairs (lmp_female_voice labels)

name: currentVoices
note: &+0x1f8 or &+0x204 by the hero's gender (RebuildHeroSlots): DrawVoiceList shows the labels (+4 of each pair), ClampVoiceSelection / OnLButtonDown index it

name: voiceScroll
note: first visible voice row (11-row window)

name: voiceSelected
note: selected voice row (OnLButtonDown rows 9..0x13 of mode 10; Up / Down keys); StartGame copies that set's '%s*.mp3' files

name: voiceChannel
note: UI_PlaySound handle of the voice sample LoadSlotSounds plays (a random sample of the hero's voice set from the sound registry g_0x7AF364); stopped and set to -1 before the next

name: vtable
note: vt 0x73D880 (base EffectRecord_Base 0x73D888); refcounted render effect built by CStateBlockSet::RegisterEffect (generic sweep A 2026-11-01)

name: passes
note: std::vector<EffectPassRecord 0x28> begin / end / capacity

name: effectId
note: returned by slot 1 GetEffectId

name: archiveListHead
note: the .res archive list (TextArchiveList: head pointer at +0 of the embedded list; entries {next, prev, name std::string, CResourceBase*}); texts.res / textsLmp.res

name: figure
note: owner figure (abstract base of CFigureClientSpecific, vt 0x73FB44: pure slots 2, 3, 11, 12); CFigure (CFigure::BindClientSpecific)

name: name
note: tileDesc.reg material name (16 records at CAIMap +0xFC materials, index = the section name as a number)

name: speed
note: tileDesc.reg Speed (default -1)

name: costMul
note: tileDesc.reg CostMul (default -1 from the reg; record default 1)

name: stepLook
note: tileDesc.reg StepLook / 100 (default 1.0)

name: stepSmell
note: tileDesc.reg StepSmell / 100 (default 1.0)

name: stepSound
note: tileDesc.reg StepSound / 100 (default 1.0); footstep loudness factor (StimulusMap::EmitFootstep)

name: packedCosts
note: pre-packed nibbles for empty dry tiles (PackMaterialCosts)
